title: Tenma Saki — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop
Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi, you're here! And Emu's here too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. We zoomed all the way here the moment the bell rang♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And now, Saki, I hope you're ready for a surprise question!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Q-Question?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. So...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Emu
rows.Line: What do we all have in common?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do we...
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki, Emu, mind if I joined you on your culinary quest...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This'll be perfect too since I was also thinking about doing something for everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thank you so much, Airi!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a feeling we can make anything as long as we have you on our side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ding, ding, ding!♪ Saki, you are correct!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, this is the reason you couldn't make it to the classroom this morning?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. Emu and I decided to come up with a surprise for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And that's why we told Haruka and the others to pass on that message.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Well you guys sure did succeed in surprising me♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well if that was enough to surprise you, then just wait and see what's next!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't forget, we're the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And what do people get on Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Uh... Chocolate, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And what do people get on their birthday?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Presents...or cake...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait! D-Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right away, Airi!
Zing-zang-zoom!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da!☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're looking at the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance Special Recipe Chocolate Birthday Cake!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It looks amazing! There's even a chocolate koala taking a snooze on top of it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, since Haruka and the others got you a koala plushie, we thought a sleeping koala would be the perfect icing on the cake♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Doesn't it look great? Emu and I worked hard on that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It looks really, really cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-but are you sure you want to give it to me?! It's just so perfect...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! You can have it as your post-lunch dessert.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I see! You did invite me here to have lunch together after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's all have lunch then.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhuuum♪ Hehe, huuum♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Today was so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I even got to celebrate with everyone in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki. Let's continue to give it our all, together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Birthdays sure are special. They're full of excitement and warmth and fun!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And now, a party with Tsukasa and everyone is waiting for me when I get home.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you also on your way home?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I am! Hm?
That's a lot of bags you're carrying.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
Shizuku and some other friends gave me a koala plushie!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I got a bunch of other presents from Ichi and the others, from Emu and even from Airi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So these are all those gifts? That was kind of them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're still a way off from home, so how about I carry half of them for you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm fine! These are precious gifts from my friends, so I want to carry them by myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of gifts, I have a little something for you from Nene and Rui. I'll give it to you when we get home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really! What is it? I can't wait to open it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You'll see!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, you look super happy, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? You think so?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If so, then perhaps it's because you're smiling?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seeing your smile makes me happier than anything else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, I have a magnificent gift in store for you, too! This time, I'll be performing to a carefully planned script rather than improvising!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh wow! What kind of show is it going to be?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh! You'll have to watch the real thing to find out the details, but it'll be a one-man show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's the story of a boy bewitched by a spell that makes his legs move when he tries to move his arms, and his arms move when he tries to move his legs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahahaha, say what now? Sounds like a fun show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's get home quick so you can show me! Race ya!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, be careful! Don't run so fast!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Saki! I'm glad I got to celebrate with you. It was super fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad you liked the koala plushie. I was a little worried that you would think it was too big.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We just knew you would love and cherish it to bits because you love plushies.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks to you guys, our surprise also turned out well, so thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're welcome, but mind telling us what your surprise was?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehehe, that's our little secret♪
Hope you had a great birthday, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki. I had so much fun celebrating your special day with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, Aoyagi, I gave Saki your color pen gift set and she loved it. She especially loved the metallic shine!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad. She seemed rather interested in those pens when I went shopping with her and Tsukasa a while back. I'm happy to hear she actually liked them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope you have a delightful birthday, Saki. May our friendship grow ever stronger.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Saki! I hope you have a super, ultra, crazy, wonderhoy birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We even got a new wonderhoy... Uh, so...happy birthday, Tenma. I hope you'll hang out with me sometime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Feel free to stop by Phoenix Wonderland sometime and we'll show you around. Hehe, of course, your tour will also include some special effects devised by me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That sounds...fun, yet somewhat unsettling. That said, a change of pace will do you some good. Feel free to stop by whenever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope you had an amazing birthday, Saki. Let's continue to keep doing our best together as a band!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It won't be long until we all go pro. The thought of it makes my heart pound.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It won't be an easy journey, but I'm sure we can overcome anything if we all work together, so keep it up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you everyone for celebrating my birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. I got so many gifts today, and I can't stop smiling!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to give everything my all, and do whatever I can to move forward♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So I'll be counting on your support!
